template.Name: GFS Auto Refinish PM Annual Service Report

questions.Name: Replace Reason
questions.Question__c: If "Replace Unit" is selected, provide reason to replace

questions.Name: Booth Identifier
questions.Question__c: Booth / unit identifier (the form repeats this block for each booth)

questions.Name: Cabin Instructions
questions.Display_Rich_Text__c: Mark the condition of each item. For any item marked Replace, attach a photo. Use the comment field to note what was serviced, adjusted, or replaced.

questions.Name: Before After Pictures
questions.Question__c: 01. Took BEFORE and AFTER pictures of unit (interior, exterior, areas of concern)

questions.Name: GFS Nozzles Blades
questions.Question__c: 04a. Advance Cure nozzles / blades (inspect and clean)

questions.Name: Ballasts
questions.Question__c: 05a. Light fixtures – ballasts (record date on replaced ballasts)

questions.Name: Bulbs
questions.Question__c: 05b. Light fixtures – bulbs (see Crash Champions 50% rule)

questions.Name: Paper Clear Cellulose Bags
questions.Question__c: 06a. Wet suppression covering – paper/clear cellulose bags (use GFS clear plug & rubber bands)

questions.Name: Linkage Wet Suppression Temp
questions.Question__c: 06b. Dry chem linkage temperature / wet suppression color (record in comment)

questions.Name: Track Splices
questions.Question__c: 10c. CTOF curtain assembly – track / track splices

questions.Name: Man Doors
questions.Question__c: 11a. Equipment doors – man door(s) (seal, track, closer, hinges, glass)

questions.Name: PMR Door from Booth
questions.Question__c: 11d. Equipment doors – PMR door from booth

questions.Name: Belt Drive Intake
questions.Question__c: 12a. Belt drive systems – intake (belt/pulley wear, tension; replace belts annually at Crash Champions)

questions.Name: Post Exhaust Filter
questions.Question__c: 13a. Filters – post-exhaust filter (clean or replace as necessary)

questions.Name: Prefilter
questions.Question__c: 13b. Filters – prefilter (clean or replace as necessary)

questions.Name: Cylinder Ext
questions.Question__c: 15a. Pneumatic operations / pressure – cylinder extension (drain regulator water as required)

questions.Name: Cleaning Instructions
questions.Display_Rich_Text__c: Perform booth cleaning (power washing), apply booth coating on interior walls, change filters, and wash exhaust fans and dampers. Waste water IS NOT to be disposed of in city drains or onto the ground.

questions.Name: Clean 01 Before Pics
questions.Question__c: 01. Took BEFORE pictures of unit (interior, exterior, areas of concern)

questions.Name: Clean 02 Remove Filters
questions.Question__c: 02. Removed booth filters (exhaust, prefilter, post-exhaust, intake)

questions.Name: Clean 03 Power Wash
questions.Question__c: 03. Power washed booth (walls, grates, doors, door windows)

questions.Name: Clean 05 Wash Fans
questions.Question__c: 05. Power washed exhaust fans and dampers (before/after pics; access holes closed after)

questions.Name: Clean 06 Waste Water
questions.Question__c: 06. Removed waste water from pit and disposed in shop-designated area (before/after pics of pit)

questions.Name: Clean 08 Remove Overspray
questions.Question__c: 08. Removed overspray from all light glass and door glass (no petroleum-based products)

questions.Name: Clean 09 Install Filters
questions.Question__c: 09. Installed new exhaust, ceiling, prefilter and post filter

questions.Name: Clean 10 After Pics
questions.Question__c: 10. Took AFTER pictures of unit (interior, exterior, areas of concern)

questions.Name: Clean 11 Trash Removed
questions.Question__c: 11. All trash from service visit removed by technician or placed in designated container

questions.Name: Waste Disposal Location
questions.Question__c: Describe store-specified waste disposal location (attach photo)

questions.Name: Airflow Instructions
questions.Display_Rich_Text__c: Using an anemometer, measure at all indicated points and record results. Balanced air differential should be no greater than 20 ft/min side to side. Recommended balanced velocity is 50–80 FPM. Booth loaded with an average mid-sized sedan.

questions.Name: Proper Clearance
questions.Question__c: Proper clearance around equipment to service?

questions.Name: Parts Used
questions.Question__c: Parts & service used (part number/description, qty, cost, shipped/van or credit card)

questions.Name: Filter Audit
questions.Question__c: Filter excess audit (part number, description, count/each)
